title: Can You Find the Train Sandwich Thief?
summary: Sam left a tuna sandwich on a train table and came back to an empty plate. Four fellow passengers, three clues, one answer. Can you solve it?

beats.text: Sam left a tuna sandwich on the train table. Twenty minutes later, it was gone. Hana, Ivo, Tom or Lena?
Four people shared Sam's table. Hana, Ivo, Tom and Lena.
Clues: Hana got off before Sam left. Ivo never eats fish. Tom slept the whole time.
Your turn, detective. Who took it?
beats.reveal: Lena! Everyone else is ruled out.

beats.text: Hana was gone, Ivo avoids fish, and Tom never moved. Only Lena could have taken it.
